Theorem
[Nonexistence of positive-curvature noncompact shrinkers] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0137 1. ch19:19.55\group $\kappa $-Gap

There is no complete noncompact three-dimensional gradient shrinking soliton with bounded positive sectional curvatures which is $\kappa $-noncollapsed at all scales.
